summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite schema.  Everything I can verify **statically looks correct**: - Schema: `watchlists.user_id` and `watchlist_items.watchlist_id` are proper foreign-key-style columns with indexes. - Every watchlist handler (list/create/get/update/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` — no cross-user leakage, no default/global
